title: 수도방위사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Duties of Commander, etc.)
(1) Except where the Commander is subject to operational command and supervision by the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff pursuant to Article 9 (3) of the Act on the Organization of the Armed Forces, the Commander shall, under the orders of the Chief of Staff of the Army, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and command and supervise units assigned or attached thereto.
(2) In conducting operational activities concerning designated security areas, the Commander shall consult with the Chief of the Presidential Security Service. <Amended on February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013; July 26, 2017>
(3) The Deputy Commander shall assist the Commander and act on behalf of the Commander where the Commander is unable to perform duties.
(4) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and coordinate, control, and supervise staff duties.
